purpose: Additional sequences selected before seeing results; no sequence-specific tuning.
pose_preparation: If ground-truth timestamps repeat, omit all samples at those timestamps in a separate documented copy; preserve the archive and source poses. Keep the existing interpolation gap limit. This resolves a conflicting duplicate in Freiburg2 Desk without selecting one pose arbitrarily.

fr1_desk2.reason: Additional office sweeps with different viewpoints.

fr1_plant.reason: Object walk-around with thin leaves and depth boundaries.

fr2_desk.reason: Longer office trajectory in a different Freiburg recording setup.

fr3_office.reason: Long household/office loop recorded with Asus Xtion.

calibration_note: Freiburg1/2 retain the existing ROS-default approximation for registered unrectified images. Freiburg3 uses published RGB intrinsics because its images are already undistorted. Identical intrinsics are used by all methods within each sequence.
evaluation_note: All pose-associated frames; every fifth associated frame held out of prediction, recovery, and fusion. Supplied GT camera poses isolate depth/fusion quality. TUM held-out sensor depth measures consistency, not independent surface accuracy. No reference-depth or mesh and no ICP/scale registration.
